Name: (CP) Vanillaish Demetrius (Genderbent Demetrius)
Author: Hitme11
Description:
Portraits for genderbent Demetrius that rivals his daughter's beauty, but in vanilla-friendly style to play with other portraits mod. Doesn't contain her sprites or change her name in-game. Still working on sprites, I swear.

Would you choose the genderbent version of Demetrius over his wife? I'd personally. 

[b]INSTRUCTION:[/b]
- Put [CP] Vanillaish Demetrius into your Mods folder.
﻿- That's it.

[b]PERMISSIONS[/b]: I don't block any of this mod content from modification. Feel free to use any of my content in your mod or upload your modification version on Nexus, credit me if you want.
